sources.title: NCSC Cyber Essentials current technical requirements

limitations: This is a partial extraction of requirements and recommendations, not a licensed assessment or certification decision.
The two native certification levels share the five technical control requirements. Cyber Essentials Plus adds independent technical testing; it does not assign a different severity classification.
Scope and the cloud shared-responsibility model require contextual review. Cloud services cannot simply be excluded from the assessment scope.
Operator facts and artifact references are unverified declarations; the pack does not inspect endpoint configuration, authenticate to cloud accounts or replay attacks.
Backup, configurable device-unlock throttle and SHOULD-worded password-protection guidance do not count as mandatory controls. The explicit MUST for an MFA password factor is represented separately.
Bespoke/custom web application components have a separate scope caveat in section D(vii). A missing XSS/SQLi finding cannot establish that these organisational controls pass.

requirements.label: Firewall coverage of scoped devices
requirements.locator: E.1 Firewalls, Requirements, printed p. 13
requirements.interpretationNotes: Assess the complete in-scope population from sanitized operator evidence; a website observation alone does not establish this control.

requirements.label: Remediate firewall default administration
requirements.locator: E.1 Firewalls, Requirements, first bullet, printed p. 14
requirements.interpretationNotes: Accept a strong unique replacement password OR fully disabled remote administration. Review every in-scope firewall; never collect the password itself.

requirements.label: Block unnecessary internet administration
requirements.locator: E.1 Firewalls, Requirements, second bullet, printed p. 14
requirements.interpretationNotes: Assess the complete in-scope population from sanitized operator evidence; a website observation alone does not establish this control.

requirements.label: Review internet administration exception
requirements.locator: E.1 Firewalls, Requirements, second bullet and exceptions, printed p. 14
requirements.interpretationNotes: A contextual reviewer must assess the claimed business need, approved exposed interface and applicable security controls. The engine must not infer an exception from an open port.

requirements.label: Protect justified internet administration
requirements.locator: E.1 Firewalls, Requirements, second bullet alternatives, printed p. 14
requirements.interpretationNotes: The IP alternative requires a small trusted address range plus properly managed password authentication. A bare allowlist or password alone does not match this profile.

requirements.label: Deny unsolicited unauthenticated inbound traffic
requirements.locator: E.1 Firewalls, Requirements, third bullet, printed p. 14
requirements.interpretationNotes: Assess the complete in-scope population from sanitized operator evidence; a website observation alone does not establish this control.

requirements.locator: E.1 Firewalls, Requirements, fourth bullet, printed p. 14
requirements.interpretationNotes: The ruleset must be reconciled to authorised approvals and recorded business reasons. Possessing a ruleset export alone does not establish approval.

requirements.interpretationNotes: Assess the complete in-scope population from sanitized operator evidence; a website observation alone does not establish this control.

requirements.locator: E.2 Secure Configuration, Requirements, second bullet, printed p. 15
requirements.interpretationNotes: Persist only the reviewer outcome and masked metadata. Raw passwords are outside this harness contract.

requirements.label: Remove unnecessary device software
requirements.locator: E.2 Secure Configuration, Requirements, third bullet, printed p. 15
requirements.interpretationNotes: Assess the complete in-scope population from sanitized operator evidence; a website observation alone does not establish this control.

requirements.locator: E.2 Secure Configuration, Requirements, fourth bullet, printed p. 15
requirements.interpretationNotes: Assess the complete in-scope population from sanitized operator evidence; a website observation alone does not establish this control.

requirements.label: Authenticate before organisational access
requirements.locator: E.2 Secure Configuration, Requirements, fifth bullet, printed p. 15
requirements.interpretationNotes: Assess the complete in-scope population from sanitized operator evidence; a website observation alone does not establish this control.

requirements.label: Device-only unlock credential length
requirements.locator: E.2 Secure Configuration, Device unlocking credentials, printed p. 16
requirements.interpretationNotes: This six-character rule applies only to passwords/PINs used solely for local unlocking. Credentials also used for authentication require the full User Access Control rules; biometrics are a separate option.

requirements.label: Protect physical device unlocking
requirements.locator: E.2 Secure Configuration, Device unlocking credentials, printed p. 16
requirements.interpretationNotes: Protect the chosen method against guessing. When the vendor exposes no configurable throttling/lockout, its default setting is the stated fallback; require contextual review of that limitation.

requirements.label: Recommended unlock throttle threshold
requirements.locator: E.2 Secure Configuration, Device unlocking credentials, throttling alternative, printed p. 16
requirements.interpretationNotes: The source introduces this configurable alternative with should. Do not turn this recommendation into a compulsory product gate or perform brute-force attempts.

requirements.label: Licensed in-scope software
requirements.locator: E.3 Security Update Management, Requirements, first bullet, printed p. 17
requirements.interpretationNotes: Assess the complete in-scope population from sanitized operator evidence; a website observation alone does not establish this control.

requirements.label: Supported in-scope software
requirements.locator: E.3 Security Update Management, Requirements, first and second bullets, printed p. 17
requirements.interpretationNotes: Unsupported software must be removed or excluded using a segregated subset that prevents all internet traffic. Scope isolation needs review; an unsupported component still in the assessed population fails.

requirements.label: Enable available automatic updates
requirements.locator: E.3 Security Update Management, Requirements, third bullet, printed p. 17
requirements.interpretationNotes: Assess the complete in-scope population from sanitized operator evidence; a website observation alone does not establish this control.

requirements.label: Qualifying security update delay
requirements.locator: E.3 Security Update Management, Requirements, fourth bullet and severity criteria, printed pp. 17–18
requirements.interpretationNotes: Qualifying means vendor critical/high risk, CVSS v3 base score >=7, OR absent vendor severity details. Measure from release to verified deployment; a bundle qualifies if any included issue qualifies. This is not a universal deadline for all updates.

requirements.label: Approve account creation
requirements.locator: E.4 User Access Control, Requirements, first bullet, printed p. 19
requirements.interpretationNotes: Assess the complete in-scope population from sanitized operator evidence; a website observation alone does not establish this control.

requirements.label: Unique user authentication credentials
requirements.locator: E.4 User Access Control, Requirements, second bullet, printed p. 19
requirements.interpretationNotes: Include organisation-owned third-party support accounts within the declared account population. Reviewer evidence must establish uniqueness without exposing credential values.

requirements.label: Disable unneeded user accounts
requirements.locator: E.4 User Access Control, Requirements, third bullet, printed pp. 19–20
requirements.interpretationNotes: The source leaves the inactivity period to the organisation. Do not invent a universal 30/45/90-day Cyber Essentials inactivity deadline.

requirements.label: Mandatory cloud-service MFA
requirements.locator: E.4 User Access Control, Requirements, MFA bullet, printed p. 20
requirements.interpretationNotes: Authentication to in-scope cloud services requires MFA without a where-available exception. The complete service/account population and permitted fallbacks require review.

requirements.label: MFA on other supported authentication
requirements.locator: E.4 User Access Control, Requirements, MFA bullet, printed p. 20
requirements.interpretationNotes: This availability qualifier concerns other authentication; it must not weaken the separate mandatory cloud-service MFA rule.

requirements.label: Separate administrative accounts
requirements.locator: E.4 User Access Control, Requirements, separate administrative accounts bullet, printed p. 20
requirements.interpretationNotes: Assess both account separation and restricted usage; ordinary email/browsing with the administrative account does not satisfy this fact.

requirements.label: Remove obsolete special privileges
requirements.locator: E.4 User Access Control, Requirements, final bullet, printed p. 20
requirements.interpretationNotes: Assess the complete in-scope population from sanitized operator evidence; a website observation alone does not establish this control.

requirements.label: Password guessing protection alternative
requirements.locator: E.4 User Access Control, Password-based authentication, guessing protection, printed p. 21
requirements.interpretationNotes: Interpret profiles as complete alternatives across every applicable path: MFA with a password factor of at least eight characters and no maximum cap; increasing attempt delays with no more than ten guesses in five minutes; or lockout after at most ten unsuccessful attempts. The source uses should for the password-protection subsection within E.4; this pack records the published control expectation, without deciding certification. Enum names are internal summaries, not native NCSC policy identifiers.

requirements.label: Password quality alternative
requirements.locator: E.4 User Access Control, MFA password element and Password-based authentication quality alternatives, printed pp. 21–22
requirements.interpretationNotes: Interpret each profile as a complete alternative: MFA with a password factor of at least eight characters and no maximum cap; at least twelve characters without a maximum cap; or at least eight characters, no maximum cap and automatic common-password blocking. The source uses should for the password-protection subsection within E.4; this pack records the published control expectation, without deciding certification. Evaluate all applicable systems, never infer from one login form.

requirements.label: Minimum length and uncapped MFA password factor
requirements.locator: E.4 User Access Control, Multi-factor authentication, explicit password-element requirement, printed p. 21
requirements.interpretationNotes: This clause uses must and applies to every password-bearing MFA path. Confirm at least eight characters and no maximum-length restriction from effective configuration and reviewer evidence. Passwordless MFA does not create a password-factor population. Store no password values.

requirements.label: Active malware protection option
requirements.locator: E.5 Malware protection, Requirements, printed pp. 23–24
requirements.interpretationNotes: Every scoped device needs a permitted active mechanism. Windows/macOS may use anti-malware; signed application allowlisting is the other stated option. Do not treat a generic scanner result as endpoint coverage.

requirements.label: Update selected anti-malware
requirements.locator: E.5 Malware protection, Anti-malware software, first bullet, printed p. 24
requirements.interpretationNotes: Assess the complete in-scope population from sanitized operator evidence; a website observation alone does not establish this control.

requirements.label: Prevent malicious code execution
requirements.locator: E.5 Malware protection, Anti-malware software, second and third bullets, printed p. 24
requirements.interpretationNotes: Assess the complete in-scope population from sanitized operator evidence; a website observation alone does not establish this control.

requirements.label: Block known malicious websites
requirements.locator: E.5 Malware protection, Anti-malware software, fourth bullet, printed p. 24
requirements.interpretationNotes: Assess the complete in-scope population from sanitized operator evidence; a website observation alone does not establish this control.

requirements.label: Allow approved signed applications only
requirements.locator: E.5 Malware protection, Application allow listing, introduction and second bullet, printed p. 24
requirements.interpretationNotes: Review the enforced application list and user installation permissions; unsigned applications and invalid signatures must not be accepted.

requirements.label: Approve applications before deployment
requirements.locator: E.5 Malware protection, Application allow listing, first bullet, printed p. 24
requirements.interpretationNotes: Assess the complete in-scope population from sanitized operator evidence; a website observation alone does not establish this control.

requirements.label: Independent Cyber Essentials Plus testing
requirements.locator: Choose your certification level / How do they compare: Cyber Essentials Plus technical audit
requirements.interpretationNotes: An appointed certification assessor must establish that the five controls operate in practice within the agreed scope. An internal metadata score, self-declaration or successful website scan is insufficient. This pack never awards certification.

requirements.label: Review recommended backup arrangements
requirements.locator: C. Backing up your data, printed pp. 5–6
requirements.interpretationNotes: Backups are explicitly outside the five mandatory technical requirements. This recommendation must not decide mandatory-control conformance.
